PRO SE INTERVENOR JOHN B. BRADLEY IIl’S (THIRD) MOTION TO ADMIT
REVISED DIRECT TESTIMONY, WITHDRAW SPECIFIED EXHIBITS, AND
REQUEST WAIVER OF APPEARANCE OR SPECIFIC HEARING DATE

TO THE HONORABLE ADMINISTRATIVE LAW JUDGE:

COMES NOW, John B. Bradley III, appearing pro se as an Intervenor in the above-
referenced docket, and files this Motion to Admit Revised Direct Testimony, Withdraw
Specified Exhibits, and Request Waiver of Appearance or a Specific Hearing Date. In
support thereof, Intervenor shows the following:

|. WITHDRAWAL OF EXHIBITS AND CORRECTION OF TESTIMONY

In response to the Applicants’ Objections (PUC Item 4726), | hereby concede the
objections regarding the formal admissibility of specific exhibits previously filed under
PUC Interchange Item 3921. Pro se Intervenor formally withdraws the exhibits listed in
Table 1 listed below from consideration with this direct testimony.

Table 1: Formally Withdrawn Exhibits

|7|8| 13] 14 | 15 | 16 | 24 | 25 | 26 | 28 | 29 | 34 | 35 | 36 | 37 | 38 | 38a | 41 | 42] 43
|44 | 45 | 46 | 48 | 49 | 54 | 76| 77 | 78| 80|

Furthermore, pro se Intervenor has revised direst testimony statements to cure the
Applicants’ evidentiary objections and ensure strict compliance with the Texas Rules of

59475 — Motion to Consolidate and Continuance Page | of 5

 Evidence. Additionally, he has removed the originally labeled "Section X. Property Value
Impacts" from direct testimony.

Evidentiary Alignment:

Pro se Intervenor’s revised direct testimony is now aligned with and admissible under
the following rules:
¢ TRE 602 (Need for Personal Knowledge): This rule requires a witness to have
personal knowledge of the matter. My revised testimony is based exclusively on
my firsthand, direct experience as a rancher and my intimate, historical familiarity
with my own property.

¢ TRE 701 (Opinion Testimony by Lay Witnesses): This rule permits lay witness
opinions if they are rationally based on the witness's perception. By removing
expert-level value impact claims (Section X) and relying solely on my direct
observations regarding the operations and characteristics of my land, my
statements fit squarely within the permissible scope of lay testimony under Texas
law.

Therefore, pro se Intervenor requests that cured revised direct testimony entered in
PUC interchange as item #4787 be formally admitted into the evidentiary record during
pre-hearing.

ll. MILITARY EXIGENCY AND REQUEST FOR HEARING ACCOMMODATIONS

Pro se Intervenor is currently an active-duty member of the United States Army with 23
years of honorable service. His current assignment, duty location, and duty status are
subject to strict mission requirements that create a significant, unavoidable conflict with
in-person attendance at the upcoming Hearing on the Merits.

As a pro se intervenor without legal representation, he has made every effort to
Participate meaningfully in this administrative process. His military service should not
unfairly disadvantage my ability to protect my property interests.

Statutory and Administrative Alignment:

This request for accommodation is supported by the following legal and administrative
standards:

e 1 TAC § 155.405: Under SOAH rules, the Administrative Law Judge has the
authority to conduct proceedings or allow witness testimony via videoconference
to promote the "convenience of the parties" and prevent "undue hardship." Given

 my military obligations and deployment constraints, an in-person appearance
constitutes an undue hardship.

* Texas Civil Practice and Remedies Code § 30.005: The spirit of this statute
mandates that courts accommodate active-duty military members whose duties
materially affect their ability to participate in legal proceedings, ensuring service
members are not penalized or denied due process as a result of their service to
the nation.

In light of these authorities, | respectfully request the relief.

Primary Request - Waiver of Appearance; Pro se Intervenor request that the parties and
the Judge waive my required appearance for cross-examination. Having withdrawn the
objected exhibits and limited my testimony strictly to my personal knowledge, my written
testimony is sufficient for the record. He does not intend to personally cross-examine
other parties, introduce witnesses, or experts.

Alternative Request - Specific Remote Setting Date and Time: If a waiver is not granted,
pro se Intervenor requests a specific, time-certain setting affording his testimony to be
conducted via Zoom on the afternoon of June 8, 2026. This specific remote setting will
allow pro se Intervenor to fulfill military duties given emergent competing requirements
while still participating in the hearing at specific time mitigating conflicts.

lll. CONCLUSION AND PRAYER

WHEREFORE, PREMISES CONSIDERED, pro se Intervenor John B. Bradley III
respectfully requests that the Administrative Law Judge grant this Motion, admit the
revised direct testimony, acknowledge the withdrawal of the specified exhibits, and
grant either a waiver of appearance or a specific remote setting via Zoom for June 8,
2026, along with any further relief to which Intervenor may be justly entitled.

Respectfully submitted,
